subject: spanish

moments.title: Cortes lands in Mexico
moments.body: Cortes burns his ships and marches inland with around 500 men.

moments.title: Fall of Tenochtitlan
moments.body: After siege and smallpox, the Aztec capital falls. It becomes Mexico City.
moments.takeaway: Indigenous allies and disease were essential to Spanish conquest.

moments.title: Inca emperor killed
moments.body: Pizarro captures Atahualpa and later executes him despite a ransom of gold. The Inca empire is conquered.
moments.takeaway: Within twelve years, two of history's largest empires fell.

now.title: Conquest's memory
now.body: Mexico's president Lopez Obrador formally requested an apology from Spain in 2019. Restitution of artefacts is ongoing.
now.open_questions: How should colonial histories be apologised for, if at all?

reflection: The Spanish empire in the Americas began in two violent decades.
